text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate on /v1/embeddings route in us-west-2 — spikes started ~09:45 UTC, customers A+B showing 500s, sample error: "incompatible_model_variant: route expects EMBEDDING model but got CHAT variant"

morgan (oncall): Acked. I'm looking now. Is this a routing/fallback thing?

jia (eng-runtime): seeing same in logs — majority of 500s have this stack: `runtime/serving: validate_variant failed: expected_type=embedding got=chat`

morgan (oncall): Any recent pin or routing change to embedding variants?

deploy-bot: Deployment event: pin-update by jia @ 09:40 UTC — modified routing policy for model_id=redwood-embed with pinned_version=redwood-chat-v2

morgan (oncall): oh. that sounds like the culprit. Looks like pin is wrong (chat variant pinned for embed route). Second check: is this a policy that allows fallback to pinned_version?

jia (eng-runtime): Yes policy allows pinned_version fallback when the requested model is unavailable. Pin update probably replaced an older embed-specific variant with a chat variant (human error in UI).

sam (sre-lead): Impact estimate? Which tenants are affected and what's the error rate?

morgan (oncall): Current 5xx rate for /v1/embeddings ~ 18% over last 10m in us-west-2. A and B are high volume. Latency for successful ones is fine.

lina (customer-ops): Customers A and B reported errors in their ingestion pipelines a few minutes ago. I'm drafting a status note. We need ETA for mitigation to avoid SLA hits.

jia (eng-runtime): Short mitigation options:
1) Remove pinned_version from policy (immediately stop fallback to chat) — quick fix.
2) Pin to the correct embedding variant (if we know the exact version) — safe if available.
3) Disable fallback globally for embed route via feature flag — more blast radius.

I recommend (1) while we validate correct embedding variant, then (2) pin to correct version and test canary.

morgan (oncall): Can we do (1) from console or API now? I can run the API call.

jia (eng-runtime): Yes — API: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood-internal/policy/remove_pin -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","env":"us-west-2"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN"` — will remove pinned_version.

morgan (oncall): Running now...

morgan (oncall): Done. Confirmed policy change in control plane. Watching logs and 5xx rate.

incident-bot: Config change recorded: policy.remove_pin by morgan @ 09:54 UTC

jia (eng-runtime): 5xx rate dropped to ~2% in the next 90s — looks like immediate mitigation worked. Still seeing a handful of failures for requests that hit unhealthy nodes, but overall stabilizing.

lina (customer-ops): Sending interim status to Customers A+B: "We've identified a routing pin misconfiguration causing embedding requests to fallback to an incompatible chat variant. We've removed the fallback pin and errors have dropped significantly. We'll follow up with full RCA and remediation plan." Want approval? :email:

sam (sre-lead): Approved. Also: open an incident ticket and link runbook. I've created INC-2026-342 in tracker and assigned to jia and morgan for follow-up.

jia (eng-runtime): Action items I will do next:
- validate available embedding variants in us-west-2 and find the latest verified embed (searching model catalog)
- if found, pin to that variant with canary (10% traffic) and monitor for schema errors
- add validation in pin UI/API to prevent cross-variant pins (embed vs chat) — blocker for permanent fix

morgan (oncall): I'll coordinate with ops to keep monitoring and handoff to next oncall in 1h. Also capture exact offending pin id from audit: `pin_id=pin-7f3a` from deploy-bot event.

deploy-bot: Audit record: pin-update pin-7f3a previous=embed-v1 new=chat-v2 by jia @ 09:40 UTC

jia (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: manual pin change via console/API where UI allowed selecting any model without variant-type validation. We need guardrails.

sam (sre-lead): Good. For postmortem include: timeline, blast radius (requests/tenants affected), detection method (pager), mitigation timeline, contributing factors, and action items. Put owner for each action.

lina (customer-ops): I'll follow up with customers after we confirm final remediation and ETA for any reingestion they might need.

morgan (oncall): Handoff: @oncall-next I'm leaving notes in INC-2026-342. System stable but keep an eye on embedding errors in us-west-2 and model pin changes.

morgan (oncall): paging @oncall-next :wave:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. morgan assigned -> oncall-next at 11:00 UTC

sam (sre-lead): Post-incident quick actions:
- jia: implement variant-type validation on pin updates (owner)
- eng-runtime: add alert for sudden mismatch errors like `incompatible_model_variant` (owner)
- product: UI text change to warn about variant types (lina to coordinate)

jia (eng-runtime): I'll start the validation PR today and target staging rollout tomorrow.

lina (customer-ops): Drafted final customer note for review: "Root cause: incorrect model pin caused embedding requests to fall back to a chat model, causing failures. Mitigation: removed the incorrect pin; errors reduced to baseline. Next steps: we'll pin to the correct embed variant with canary and implement validation to prevent recurrence." Sending to sam for signoff.

sam (sre-lead): Signoff. Add postmortem link to the incident ticket once ready.

morgan (oncall): Closing pager for now. Reopen if error rate > 5% sustained for 5m.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Ticket INC-2026-342 created.

[thread closed after handoff]
